evidence.observation: GO2-C1 requires "no preview is written" and an outcome report; GO3-C1 requires "from the GO2-C1 preview". That fixture has no preview to pass to GO3.

concerns.recommendation: Make GO3-C1 consume the GO2-C1 outcome report and specify how narrowing obtains the original model document needed to replay the admitted operations.
concerns.title: GO3-C1 requires a nonexistent preview

evidence.observation: GO5 says the summary is computed from "a round file the host writes plus, when the round produced one, the proposal and its preview or outcome report" and reports "the elements added". D4 likewise proposes computation "from the proposal and the preview". The same stated inputs exist whether a preview was subsequently applied or abandoned, so they cannot establish which elements were added to the model.

concerns.recommendation: Require finalization evidence or a verified resulting model identity for the added-elements count, and test otherwise identical applied and unapplied rounds.
concerns.title: GO5 lacks evidence of actual additions

summary: GO3 names a preview that cannot exist, and GO5 cannot distinguish proposed additions from applied additions using its stated inputs.
